title: VGI
subtitle: Attach a worker. Query its capabilities.
intro: Vector Gateway Interface connects DuckDB to workers written in other languages. A worker advertises catalogs, tables and functions; attach a catalog and query it alongside local data over a subprocess or HTTP connection.

reference.name: vgi_catalogs(location)
reference.description: Discover catalog names, options and versions before attaching.

reference.name: ATTACH catalog (TYPE vgi, LOCATION …)
reference.description: Select the advertised catalog and the worker that serves it.

reference.name: vgi_table_function(worker, fn, args)
reference.description: Call a worker table function directly; args is a LIST.

reference.name: vgi_oauth_identity()
reference.description: Inspect authenticated identity for attached catalogs.

reference.name: vgi_worker_pool()
reference.description: List reusable subprocess workers and their process identifiers.

reference.name: vgi_worker_pool_stats()
reference.description: Inspect worker reuse through per-path hits and misses.

reference.name: CALL vgi_clear_cache()
reference.description: Clear cached catalog metadata for attached VGI catalogs.

notes.title: Catalog name and location differ
notes.body: The ATTACH identifier is a catalog advertised by the worker. LOCATION identifies its URL or executable. Replace example catalog, schema and table names with discovery results. Pushdown and writable tables depend on the worker's capabilities.

notes.title: Choose where code runs
notes.body: Local workers execute with your process privileges; use workers you trust. HTTP workers run in their own environment and may require OAuth. Browser builds use HTTP transport. Community extension availability varies by DuckDB version and platform.
